name: Monsoon Garden Tote
tagline: A bouquet of brushstrokes, carried on your shoulder.
description: Every petal on this tote is painted freehand on natural cotton canvas, so no two bags are ever identical. Warm terracotta, saffron and sage strokes sit on a soft, undyed base — a piece of wearable art for markets, travel and everyday life.
alt: Hand-painted natural canvas tote bag with terracotta, saffron and sage green floral brushstrokes
technique: Painted freehand with a brush, one stroke at a time

name: Sandstone Knot Bag
tagline: Thousands of knots. One quiet statement.
description: Knotted entirely by hand from thick natural cotton cord in a lattice of diamonds, finished with a warm wooden handle and a generous fringe. Light, airy and sculptural — it turns any outfit into something considered.
alt: Hand-knotted macramé shoulder bag in natural cream cotton cord with a wooden handle and fringe

name: Marigold Knot Crossbody
description: The piece that captures the whole A.S. Touch idea: a hand-painted marigold panel framed by hand-knotted cord and a braided strap. Compact enough for every day, special enough to be noticed.
alt: Small crossbody bag combining hand-knotted cream cord with a hand-painted golden marigold panel
technique: Hand-painted panel framed with hand-knotted cord

name: Indigo Tide Bucket Bag
tagline: The sea, captured in a single sweep of the brush.
description: Flowing waves of deep indigo roll across ivory canvas, touched with tiny accents of gold. A drawstring bucket bag with a rope strap — effortless for coastal days and city evenings alike.
alt: Ivory canvas bucket bag hand-painted with deep indigo waves and gold accents
technique: Painted freehand in layered indigo washes

name: Midnight Bloom Clutch
description: Blush, peach and gold peonies bloom against deep midnight navy. A hand-painted evening clutch with a gold zip — a small canvas you can take to dinner, weddings and celebrations.
alt: Midnight navy hand-painted clutch bag with blush pink and gold peony flowers
technique: Painted freehand, florals built up in thin layers

name: Pearl Charm Key Tag
tagline: A tiny piece of art for your keys and bags.
description: Freshwater-style pearls and a hand-knotted cord tassel, finished with a gold clasp. Clip it to a bag, keys or a zip — a small gift that feels truly personal.
alt: Handmade pearl and knotted cord tassel charm key tag with a gold clasp
